name: Privacy Page - Cookie Table On A Phone
description: The privacy page at 390px, scrolled to its cookie table — the only markdown table on the site. Unstyled, it ran off a small phone and scrolled the whole page sideways (found by the October responsive sweep at 320 and 360px). It now keeps to the text column: all four columns fit at 390px, and on a narrower phone it scrolls inside its own box while the page stays still.
